description: Verify that Burst Subscribe → observe DUT SD session_id wrap 0xFFFF → 0x0001
approach:
[Objective]
Session ID wrap: 16-bit field wraps from 0xFFFF to 0x0001 (NOT 0x0000 — session_id 0 is reserved).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Burst many SD messages to drive DUT's SD session_id near 0xFFFF.
3. Observation: session_id wraps to 0x0001.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_wrap_observed: No session_id wrap within listen window
